Implementation of REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT / safe path normalization: - src/rules/valid-annotation-format.ts - Rule-level annotations and fixable metadata: - Multiple JSDoc blocks reference this story and REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT/SAFE/PRESERVE, e.g.: - `@story docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md` - `@req REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT - Provide safe, minimal automatic fixes for common format issues` - `meta.fixable: "code"` with explicit comment: - Fixes are "limited strictly to adjusting the suffix portion of the @story path (e.g., adding `.md` or `.story.md`), preserving all other comment text and whitespace exactly as written." (REQ-AUTOFIX-SAFE and REQ-AUTOFIX-PRESERVE).
- Core helpers for safe, minimal fixes: - `createStoryFix(context, comment, fixed)`: - Obtains raw comment text via `sourceCode.getText(comment)`. - Locates the `@story` tag and then its value range using a whitespace-aware regex; returns `null` if it cannot reliably identify the value region. - Computes an exact `[start, end]` range inside the comment for just the path substring and creates a fixer: - `fixer.replaceTextRange(fixRange, fixed)` - This ensures only the story path portion is altered, preserving other comment structure. - `reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix(context, comment, collapsed, fixed)`: - Calls `createStoryFix`. If it returns `null`, it falls back to plain error reporting via `reportInvalidStoryFormat` (no fix), ensuring safety in ambiguous cases. - When a fix is available, reports `invalidStoryFormat` with a `fix` created from the factory, using default options via `getResolvedDefaults()`. - `validateStoryAnnotation(context, comment, rawValue, options)`: - Normalizes and collapse whitespace. - Uses `options.storyPattern` to check validity. - Rejects values containing whitespace (no auto-fix attempt in such cases). - First calls `getFixedStoryPath(collapsed)` to compute a potential normalized path. - Only calls `reportInvalidStoryFormatWithFix` when: - `fixed` is non-null, **and** - `pathPattern.test(fixed)` succeeds. - Otherwise falls back to error-only reporting with no fix.
- src/rules/helpers/valid-annotation-utils.ts - Implements the safe normalization logic used above: - `getFixedStoryPath(original: string): string | null`: - Returns `null` (no fix) if the path contains `".."` (path traversal) or already ends with `.story.md`. - For `*.story` ➜ `*.story.md` (adds `.md`). - For `*.md` ➜ `*.story.md` (ensure `.story` segment present). - For paths with no extension ➜ appends `.story.md`. - Does **not** modify directories or any path segments except the suffix. - This directly fulfills: - REQ-AUTOFIX-FORMAT (normalizing suffix) - REQ-AUTOFIX-SAFE (no broadening, skips traversal) and - REQ-AUTOFIX-PRESERVE (only suffix substring changed; rest of comment untouched via `createStoryFix`).

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX are satisfied by the current implementation. The plugin provides auto-fix for missing @story annotations on functions and methods via traceability/require-story-annotation, and safe @story path suffix normalization via traceability/valid-annotation-format. These behaviors are thoroughly covered by tests (tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts), wired into the ESLint rules with meta.fixable="code" and conservative fixer logic, and documented in user-docs/api-reference.md. Deferred requirements (configurable templates and selective fix types) are explicitly out of scope for this iteration and do not block story completion.
